reviews.outcome: The entry proves ordered-goal soundness, finite least-model proof-tree completeness for arbitrary atom selection, tracked-variable MGU lifting and existential-query completeness using a protected generator. Effective breadth-first search is separated from depth-first termination. The corrected two-successor example is an explicit two-step query, with an all-triples model demonstrating that positive clauses do not exactly specify addition in every model.
